_meta.role: Senior Software Engineer, Embedded Test Automation

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with embedded systems and hardware integration experience across STM32, NVIDIA Jetson, Arduino, and Raspberry Pi. Built bare-metal C firmware (UART, I2C, ADC) and Python tooling for real-time data acquisition in a laboratory environment. Ran hardware-in-the-loop trials on a Jetson and Arduino robotic system to 100% pick reliability (10/10) and deployed it as a Linux systemd service.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 hardware/software integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) in hardware-in-the-loop trials on the physical arm; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system over a three-layer distributed pipeline: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller on a unified WebSocket fabric.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++ driving five servos; integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors over a TCA9548A I2C mux for contact-aware grasping (gripper close at 25 mm).
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation, environment-file config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device registration.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver on Cortex-M4 firmware.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART with interrupt-driven handling and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
